I replied in #north-team, in Marcus's thread, and did not give him a single date.

The record conflicts. Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct, then corrected it the same morning in #north-random to 10 June, saying she had read the wrong line. I told Marcus both, and asked him to check with Ilse before updating the sheet. I can't see anyone confirming either date.

My reply says "10 June is the latest date," which is loosely worded. It is the later of the two posts, not a confirmed date.
